name: The Rethban Gauntlet
summary: In Lakeshire, Yorus Barleybrew sends challengers on a perilous run north and back. They drink his family's fiery Barleybrew Scalder, reach Rethban Caverns, and return within an hour.

sections.title: A Dwarven Dare
sections.body: In Lakeshire, grim talk of gnoll raids and missing town guards fills the inn. The dwarf Yorus Barleybrew offers a different kind of diversion: a test of speed, courage, and endurance. Before setting out on foot for the northern foothills, challengers drink a draught of his family's Barleybrew Scalder.

sections.title: Running the Wild Hills
sections.body: Redridge gnolls roam the hills between Lakeshire and Rethban Caverns. Runners must fight or slip past their packs, reach the first fork inside the dark tunnels, then hurry back to Yorus within an hour. The fiery drink makes the run harder, leaving challengers staggering as they make their way through the hills.

faq.answer: Yorus Barleybrew, a dwarven brewer staying in Lakeshire, challenges travelers to run the gauntlet and test their fortitude and his brew.

faq.q: What makes this challenge particularly difficult?
faq.answer: Runners face gnoll packs in the Redridge foothills and have only an hour. First they drink Barleybrew Scalder, which leaves them severely intoxicated and struggling to keep their balance.

faq.q: Where are the Rethban Caverns located?
aliases: how to get to rethban caverns
faq.answer: Rethban Caverns lie in the northern foothills of Redridge Mountains, northwest of Lakeshire. The path runs north past local homesteads toward crags inhabited by gnoll packs.

faq.q: How far into the caves must a runner go?
faq.answer: Challengers need only reach the first fork inside the caverns, then turn back and race to Lakeshire.

faq.q: Who inhabits the hills and caverns along the route?
faq.answer: Hostile Redridge gnolls overrun the area around the route and the caverns. Runners need stealth or swift combat to survive the trek.

faq.q: Where does this challenge lead next?
aliases: what quest comes after rethban gauntlet
faq.answer: Surviving the gauntlet proves your endurance to Yorus Barleybrew and opens the way to further tasks in the region, such as seeking out the shieldsmith Furen Longbeard in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may recognize Yorus's boisterous idea of fun: mixing potent family liquor with a dangerous mountain sprint.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help Lakeshire face the gnoll threat by braving the gauntlet and thinning the enemy patrols near the northern caves.
